name: viperIDE
description: MicroPython/CircuitPython IDE with full remote control. Connect to devices via USB serial, browse files, edit code, execute scripts, and interact with the REPL.

tools.name: viperIDE_get_status
tools.description: Get IDE connection status, device info, and editor state

tools.name: viperIDE_connect_serial
tools.description: Connect to a MicroPython device via USB serial

tools.name: viperIDE_list_serial_ports
tools.description: List available USB serial ports with device details

tools.name: viperIDE_connect_device
tools.description: Connect via WebSocket or virtual device

tools.name: viperIDE_list_files
tools.description: List files and directories on the device

tools.name: viperIDE_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the device

tools.name: viperIDE_write_file
tools.description: Write a file to the device

tools.name: viperIDE_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the device

tools.name: viperIDE_run_file
tools.description: Execute the current file on the device
